items.title: Cosimo Matassa Interview, 1993-11-01
items.q: We'd go to Lovata's for oyster sandwiches and things like that.

ctx.x: Yeah, there were places we could go to eat. Mostly black places that tolerated whites as opposed to the other way around, you know. We'd go to Lovata's for oyster sandwiches and things like that.
It's on Claiborne near the Claiborne Circle.
